name: Sitronix Technology Corporation
summary: Sitronix Technology Corporation designs, manufactures, and supplies integrated circuits (ICs) and memory chips in Hong Kong, Vietnam, South Korea, Taiwan, and internationally. The company engages in the research, development, and sales of multi-functional integrated automotive display driver ICs; AIoT device display driver chip for smart home, smart medical, and smart wearable mobile device applications; Medium-sized TFT-LCD Driver IC used in portable devices, industrial displays, and automotive systems. It also offers industrial display driver IC; projected capacitive touch controller IC; and alternator regulators. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.
